# ankra_pipeline_schedule (Resource)

A cron schedule that starts a repository's Ankra pipeline. The counterpart of `ankra pipeline schedules create`, `update` and `delete`, and of the same commands under `ankra application pipeline`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_pipeline_schedule" "nightly" {
  application_id = ankra_application.web.id
  cron           = "0 3 * * *"
  timezone       = "Europe/Oslo"

  inputs = {
    suite = "full"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cron` (String) Five-field cron expression.

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) Application whose linked repository the schedule runs. Set exactly one of `application_id` and `repository_id`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule fires. Defaults to `true`.
- `inputs` (Map of String) Pipeline inputs the scheduled run starts with.
- `ref` (String) Branch or tag the scheduled run checks out. Unset runs the default branch.
- `repository_id` (String) Connected repository that the schedule runs. Set exactly one of `application_id` and `repository_id`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone the expression is read in. Defaults to `UTC`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the schedule.
- `next_fire_at` (String) When the schedule next fires.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by application/<application_id>/<schedule_id> or repository/<repository_id>/<schedule_id>.
terraform import ankra_pipeline_schedule.nightly application/5b0c4a9e-2f43-4b8e-9a51-1f0d8e7c2a10/7a1b2c3d-4e5f-4a6b-9c8d-7e6f5a4b3c2d
```
